measures.title: Adoption of the Council-Manager Form of Government
measures.what_it_does: Changes Benton City from the mayor-council to the council-manager form of government, effective March 1, 2027: the council would hire a professional city manager and choose a mayor from among its members.
measures.cost_line: No tax change; the city would pay a full-time manager in place of the elected mayor.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.title: Community Safety Levy Lid Lift
measures.what_it_does: Restores Benton City's regular property tax levy to $1.60 per $1,000 for 2027 to fund law and code enforcement, with CPI-based increases through 2036 (never above $1.60).
measures.cost_line: $1.60 per $1,000 of assessed value for 2027 collection.

taxes.basis: YES approves a local tax, levy, bond, or annexation measure for the listed public service.

measures.title: Educational Programs and Operation Replacement Levy
measures.what_it_does: Authorizes a two-year educational programs and operation levy replacing an expired levy.
measures.cost_line: Estimated $1.30 per $1,000 of assessed value: $2,208,341 in 2027 and $2,318,758 in 2028.
